evidence: MemorySearch uses hybrid scoring with ChromaDB (col.query() and col.get()). Score components: name boost (+40% weight on topic/id exact or prefix match), staleness penalty (-20% for AGING, -50% for STALE, -100% for EXPIRED/SUPERSEDED), confidence boost (base confidence from drawer field). Dedup via seen_drawer_ids set. ChromaDB GetResult object has .ids, .metadatas, .documents attributes (not dict). 2931 total docs in palace as of mempalace Phase 2 completion. wing_sessions drawers from ConvoMiner have no wabblespec_schema_version — MemoryMine classifies them as needs_rebuild (correct, secondary/unverified). 73 JSONL files mined via ConvoMiner into wing_sessions.
